messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal statutory holidays** that create long‑weekend breaks in Canada during 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is the following Monday, which extends the break.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Observed (if needed) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|--------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Mon Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Tue) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | — | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | — | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Mon Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | — | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | — | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | — | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces also observe *Family Day* (Feb 20 (Monday)) and *Civic Holiday* (Aug 7 (Monday)), which also form long weekends in those regions.  
> • *Remembrance Day* (Nov 11 (Thursday)) is a statutory holiday in several provinces but not nationwide, so it isn’t listed here.  

Feel free to plug these date ranges straight into your holiday‑planning app!
